newsitem.title: USA: Attys General to announce pact with AOL.
newsitem.headline: Attys General to announce pact with AOL.

text.p: Illinois Attorney General Jim Ryan said Wednesday he will announce an agreement with America Online Inc covering 37 states.
The news conference, in which attorneys general from other states will participate, was set for 1330 CST (1930 GMT).
State prosecutors met with lawyers from America Online, the nation's largest online service, last week in Chicago to discuss the company's difficulties in meeting consumer demand.

Since the Dulles, Virginia-based company introduced a flat-fee unlimited usage plan in December for its eight million customers, users have complained of getting busy signals and being unable to log on to the system with their computers.
